---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new tool, a new protocol, or an improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What problem does this solve?**
The use case, from the point of view of someone asking an agent to do something.

**Which protocol project?**
- [ ] BACnet
- [ ] DNP3
- [ ] EtherCAT
- [ ] EtherNet/IP
- [ ] Modbus
- [ ] MQTT / Sparkplug B
- [ ] OPC UA
- [ ] PROFIBUS
- [ ] PROFINET
- [ ] S7comm
- [ ] mcp-manager-ui
- [ ] A protocol not yet covered — which one:

**Proposed solution**
If it is a new tool: its name, arguments, and what it returns. Tool names and
arguments are kept consistent across all ten servers, so say how it lines up
with the equivalent tool elsewhere in the suite.

**Does it write to a device?**
- [ ] No — read-only
- [ ] Yes — it changes physical equipment

**Can the mock answer it?**
What the mock device would need to be able to simulate for this to be testable
without real plant.

**Additional context**
Links to the protocol specification, example devices, or related issues.
